overview_description.description: Stord provides commerce enablement software and logistics services for e-commerce and omnichannel brands. The company offers order management, warehouse management, inventory planning, fulfillment, transportation, returns processing, and last-mile delivery solutions through an integrated platform. Its software tools help businesses manage inventory visibility, automate order routing, coordinate multichannel operations, and improve shipment tracking across supply chain networks. Stord also supports direct-to-consumer and business-to-business operations with fulfillment infrastructure and transportation services designed to connect digital commerce systems with physical logistics processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Stord provides commerce enablement software and logistics services for e-commerce and omnichannel brands.

product.name: Fulfillment Services
product.description: Warehousing and order fulfillment for direct-to-consumer, B2B, retail, omnichannel, and subscription brands, including inventory handling, picking, packing, and shipping.

product.name: Order Management System (OMS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing e-commerce orders, inventory, exceptions, and fulfillment workflows across channels, facilities, and locations.

product.name: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
product.description: Warehouse operations software for controlling inventory, receiving and shipping activity, order fulfillment, and warehouse workflows.

product.name: Transportation and Last-Mile Services
product.description: Freight, parcel, and delivery services covering transportation planning, parcel shipping, last-mile optimization, retail consolidation, and shipment monitoring.

product.name: Stord AI
product.description: AI tools for querying commerce and logistics data, monitoring operational events, assisting with order and inventory decisions, and creating or analyzing fulfillment workflows.

product.name: Consumer Experience Software
product.description: Pre- and post-purchase tools for displaying delivery promises, sending order updates, providing branded tracking, supporting personalized unboxing, and managing shipment issues.
